name: apollo
description: Apollo prospecting and enrichment — official MCP server

requirements: Apollo account with access to the records you want
AI model training turned off in your client
notes: OAuth 2.0 for interactive clients; headless clients send a MASTER key in the X-Api-Key header (scoped keys are rejected with 403 API_INACCESSIBLE).
People search reads and consumes no credits; company search, enrichment, validation and research consume credits.
Apollo prohibits AI model training on its data.
Destructive bulk delete is not supported.
